name: The House of Blue Lanterns
region_detail: A junction of established caravan routes near an oasis settlement.
site_type: caravanserai | Inhabited locations | Established caravanserai, market courtyard, and craft workshops.
history: The caravanserai grew around a dependable watering station maintained by Qasari merchants. Its courtyard was gradually enclosed by guest chambers, stables, storage rooms, and workshops. Blue-glass lamps manufactured by local artisans traditionally mark the entrance after dusk.
current_state: The house accommodates caravans traveling between the oasis settlements and the northern frontier. Resident craftspeople repair harnesses, weapons, and trade equipment, while merchants arrange escorts and exchange information about routes. Its keepers continue to recognize customary hospitality and water regulations despite increasing foreign traffic.
inhabitants: Qasari innkeepers, artisans, merchants, caravan guards, camel handlers, and travelers of various ancestries.
danger_level: Low within the caravanserai; ordinary hazards along surrounding routes.
points_of_interest:
Blue-glass entrance lamps; enclosed courtyard; shaded market stalls; glassworkers’ shop; weaponsmith’s workshop; stables; guest chambers; communal cistern; route notices.

Unresolved elements: The names and relationships of the resident keepers and artisans; The precise extent of the surrounding oasis settlement; Which commercial agreements, if any, are negotiated here as the frontier develops.
discovery: A junction of established caravan routes near an oasis settlement. Qasari caravan guides and merchants know the house. Sahir Keshan can recommend it to travelers seeking traditional Qasari craftsmanship.
related_records:
Job: J-WB-012 — Southern Caravan Rights! — Potential. Competing merchants may use the house as a meeting place or staging point while negotiating passage to an oasis.
